inner_folds.rule: Rank training people by ascending sha256('physics-source-inner-v1|' + subject code); fold = rank mod 4. People added at binding (walking-scale training rungs) are ranked together with these 18 by the same rule, unless the coverage test in PROTOCOL.md section 4 selects the walking-scale folds.

data_efficiency_subsets.rule: For n in (3, 6, 12) and subset s in 0..4, rank the 18 people by ascending sha256('physics-source-subset-v1|' + s + '|' + subject code) and take the first n. n = 18 is the single set of all 18. The full pool (18 plus walking-scale training rungs) is the last point of the curve.

bodies.rule: Scrambled Sobol sequence in natural index order, 10 dimensions, Joe-Kuo direction numbers, linear matrix scramble plus digital shift with bits from sha256('physics-source-allocation-v1|sobol-scramble|seed20261127|dim' + d + '|block' + b). u = (integer + 0.5) / 2^32. Generators use prefixes: G1 B0000-B0127, G4 B0000-B0599, G3c B0000-B0031, G3f B0000-B0015; diversity series 1, 8, 32 and 128 bodies.

mapping.mass_kg: BMI = 18 + 16 u1; mass = BMI * stature^2, clipped to 45..115 kg (mass_clipped records it)
mapping.thigh_shank_ratio_factor: 1 + 0.12 (u2 - 0.5): thigh length times sqrt(f), shank length divided by sqrt(f)
mapping.strength_factor: (0.6 + 0.7 u5) * (mass / 75 kg)^(2/3), multiplies every muscle peak isometric force
mapping.vmax_l0_per_s: 8 + 4 u6, muscle maximum shortening velocity in optimal fibre lengths per second
mapping.contact_time_constant_s: 0.02 + 0.02 u7, MuJoCo solref time constant of foot-floor contacts
mapping.friction: 0.6 + 0.6 u8, sliding friction of foot-floor contacts
mapping.speed_factor: 0.8 + 0.45 u9; G1 target speeds = speed_factor * (0.9, 1.0, 1.1) * 1.25 m/s * sqrt(stature / 1.70), clipped to 0.95..1.70 m/s; G4 target speed = speed_factor * reference speed * sqrt(stature / reference stature), clipped to 0.95..1.70 m/s
